title.zh: 将索索贡省 Magallanes 市镇 Cagbolo 描笼涯的 Magallanes 国立职业中学的 Cagbolo 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立职业中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Magallanes National Vocational High School - Cagbolo Annex in Barangay Cagbolo, Municipality of Magallanes, Province of Sorsogon From the Magallanes National Vocational High School, Converting It Into An Independent National Vocational High School to Be Known as Cagbolo National Vocational High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National Vocational High School. – The Magallanes National Vocational High School – Cagbolo Annex in Barangay Cagbolo, Municipality of Magallanes, Province of Sorsogon is hereby separated from the Magallanes National Vocational High School and converted into an independent national vocational high school to be known as Cagbolo National Vocational High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Magallanes National Vocational High School – Cagbolo Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Cagbolo National Vocational High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Cagbolo National Vocational High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Magallanes National Vocational High School – Cagbolo Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
